purpose: Phase 7 independent-judge predictions and reference metrics

models.independence_note: Evaluator uses a different configured model from all generation stages. Research, summarizer, and answer stages share models where listed; separate model names alone do not establish complete evaluator independence.

limitations: Judge outputs are automated LLM judgments and require human validation.
BLEU/METEOR/BERTScore measure similarity to gold, not factual correctness.
Generation stages share one model; see models.shared_generation_model_groups.
